mapper.select: SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID as itemId, p.PRODUCT_NAME as itemName, p.PRICE as dailyPrice, i.IMG_URL as imgUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img i ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID AND i.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID = #{itemId} AND p.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'RENTAL'
SELECT START_DATE as startDate, RETURN_DATE as returnDate FROM rentals WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND RENTAL_STATUS IN ('RESERVED', 'RENTING') AND RETURN_DATE >= CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rentals (ITEM_ID, USER_ID, START_DATE, RETURN_DATE, RENTAL_STATUS) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{userId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, 'RESERVED')
